metadata.title: Free Online IQ Tests Compared: What Results Do You Get?
metadata.description: Compare four free IQ test paths: result fields, email requirements, demo limits and timed practice. See what we checked and choose a mode for your goal.

faq_items.question: Which free IQ tests let me see results without an email?
faq_items.answer: In our checked English sessions, FermatMind's original 30-question form, 123test's eight-question Culture fair demo, ARealMe Quick and Mensa Norway practice reached free results without an email or account registration. This does not cover every mode or paid report from those providers.

faq_items.question: Does ARealMe Quick include the complete profile?
faq_items.answer: Our Quick result invited us to answer 70 more questions for the profile. The provider describes Complete as 119 questions with a profile and optional free certificate; those outputs were not obtained in this review.

faq_items.question: Will Mensa Norway always display an exact IQ number?
faq_items.answer: Do not assume so. Our completed synthetic path returned a below-100 range message. Its introductory score description does not guarantee an exact number for every result, and practice does not qualify you for membership.

faq_items.question: Which tool is the most accurate?
faq_items.answer: This access-and-output comparison cannot establish that. Accuracy requires evidence for a particular instrument, population, version and use; seeing a score or completing a free path does not provide that evidence.
